description: A court on the Indonesian island of Bali has sentenced a Swiss tourist to one year in prison for insulting a sacred Balinese Hindu day. Luzian Andrin Zgraggen was found guilty of violating Indonesia's new criminal code by posting social media messages about the Day of Silence, when people are required to stay home and are urged to remain silent.

author: CNN
description:
The images of thousands of people storming the borders of the Spanish exclave of Ceuta sent chills down the spine of many in Spain and across Europe who have tried to walk the fine line between the need for migrant workers and the rising anti-immigration sentiment echoed by radical right parties all over the continent.

As CNN's Jomana found out, there are few places where that paradox plays out as vividly as it does in Spain's province of Almería, Europe's vegetable garden, which is fuelled in great part by migrant-labour. 

0:00 Spain's economy relies heavily on foreign labor
3:00 A glimpse at the grueling migrant work
4:19 Foreign labor gives birth to communities and controversy
5:55 'If I had something back home, I wouldn't have come'

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

#Spain #Immigration #News
title: Spain’s paradox: Anti-migration vs the demand for grueling labor

author: CNN
description:
The editor-in-chief of the "Stars and Stripes" military newspaper who was just fired by the Pentagon is now speaking out in his first interview since his termination. Erik Slaven says he was fired for insubordination after telling CBS news any censorship of news for military service members would cross a "red line." Slavin tells Erin Burnett he is "proud" to uphold a standard "put into place by General Dwight Eisenhower during World War II."

Read more: https://cnn.it/4xac8Sn
title: Stars and Stripes editor just fired by Pentagon speaks out
